coach.bio: Known affectionately as Ustaad Abu Huraira across Punjab bodybuilding circuits, Coach Abu Huraira has shaped Kasur's strength and fitness culture from the ground up. Combining traditional discipline with modern sports science, he provides direct personal guidance to everyday fitness seekers and championship competitors alike.

faq.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faq.answer: We accept cash payments only at our front desk. Please visit during open hours to complete your registration.

faq.question: What are your daily opening and closing hours?
faq.answer: Abu Huraira World Gym is open 7 days a week and closes at 12:00 AM (Midnight). For specific morning opening times and quiet hour slots, message us directly on WhatsApp.

faq.question: Are there dedicated training hours for women?
faq.answer: Our community has historically welcomed both men and women. Because session allocations can adjust seasonally, please message us on WhatsApp before visiting so we can advise you on the current ladies' hours.

faq.question: Who will guide my workouts?
faq.answer: All members have access to the floor coaches and direct mentorship from Ex Mr. Kasur Ustaad Abu Huraira, ensuring you learn correct exercise mechanics and safe progression from day one.

faq.question: Is the gym suitable for teenagers and beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. We pride ourselves on a welcoming, disciplined atmosphere that is safe for youths, beginners, and seasoned athletes alike. No prior gym experience is required.

faq.question: Do I need an appointment for a trial session?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are always warmly welcomed. You can also send a quick WhatsApp message with your name and fitness goal so our coaching team can greet you upon arrival.
